symbols.read: Bias stays bullish and has strengthened: price broke cleanly through the 351.73 entry trigger and now sits at 365.48, well above it, with the combined 1D+1H signal holding BUY and the 1H trend up. The key levels are 351.73, now flipped from resistance to support, and the 377.65 target overhead; the open FVGs that previously sat beneath price have been consumed, so the 349.82 stop is the line that matters. Invalidation: a close below 349.82 returns the stance to neutral, while a break below 325.81 kills the bullish 1D structure.

The short setup has played out: price broke decisively below the 246.08 pivot and has extended to 231.99, well on the way to the 226.82 target, so the neutral-to-short bias from the prior read is confirmed and now firmly bearish on the 1D with the 1H trend still down. The 246.08 entry is now far behind price and no longer actionable at market; the remaining ~5 points to 226.82 is the live objective, with the 248.14 stop irrelevant unless price fully retraces. All open FVGs are now filled (none remain), removing the 251.27–251.48 upside magnet that previously threatened the short. Bias stays short toward 226.82; invalidation is a reclaim of 246.08, which would flip the structure back to neutral and void the downside case.

AVGO has firmed from 344.43 to 359.10, a clear recovery that confirms the 1H uptrend and keeps the combined view at HOLD against the bearish 1D. The prior read flagged the 346.90–347.50 bull FVGs as overhead resistance; price has now cleared them and no open FVGs remain, so that resistance has flipped to support and the near-term bear case has lost momentum. Bias is neutral-to-bullish while price sits between the pivots, with 380.84 the level that flips the structure long (entry 380.84, stop 377.29, target 441.45). The bear case is not dead but is now further from activation: it requires a sustained break below 338.03, targeting 320.23 then 259.62, with stop at 323.59. Invalidation of the bullish lean is a sustained move back below 338.03.

The bullish reclaim has fully failed: price collapsed from 749.80 to 692.31, breaking decisively below both the 742.17 and 745.95–748.14 bull FVGs, so the prior neutral-to-bullish bias is revised to bearish. The 1H trend has flipped down and the combined regime moved from BUY to HOLD/NEUTRAL, with all open FVGs now cleared — no support shelves remain beneath price. The 754.29 BUY setup is confirmed invalidated, and the 732.45 lower pivot now sits above price as overhead resistance rather than a downside target. Bias is bearish while price holds below 732.45; invalidation of that bias is a sustained reclaim of 732.45, and only a break back above 754.29 would restore the long case toward 776.13.

BRK.B has reclaimed the 549.96 upper pivot decisively, with price at 572.25 now well above it, confirming the prior watch trigger and validating the BUY (WATCHING) bias. The 1D direction remains bullish and the 1H trend is up, though the last 1H bar slipped 544.16→543.20 and the combined signal reads HOLD, so momentum is not yet confirming the breakout. With no open FVGs beneath price, there is no cushion on a pullback, making 549.96 the key invalidation level — a loss of it reopens the 538.58–539.20 shelf and the 495.96 lower pivot. Bias stays bullish while price holds above 549.96, with 603.96 as the target.

Bias flips back from BUY to SELL: price at 78,876.00 has broken below the 80,418.67–81,178.31 bull FVG and the 80,451.18 lower pivot, filling the demand zone that the prior read said to defend and invalidating the BUY exactly on its stated condition. The 4H has turned bearish and the 1H trend is down, so the relief bounce is dead and the prior upside focus on 84,898.00 is off the table. With no open FVGs and a neutral regime, the active setup is the SELL at 80,451.18 with stop 80,646.25 and target 76,004.36, now live rather than invalidated. Invalidation of this SELL is a reclaim of 80,451.18 and a close back above the filled bull gap, which would reopen the upside toward 84,898.00.

Bias flips back to bearish: price at 2,261.28 has broken decisively below the 2,351.55 lower pivot that the prior read required to hold as support, voiding the bullish lean and confirming the invalidation condition it named. The 4H direction has flipped to bearish, the 1H trend is down, and the combined stance is now HOLD with no open FVGs, so the prior bull FVG support at 2,332.32–2,344.74 has been fully consumed and no longer cushions price. With the SELL signal INVALIDATED at entry 2,351.55 (stop 2,351.74), no live trade exists; 2,351.55 now acts as resistance overhead, with 2,176.48 the downside target and 2,526.62 the upside pivot. Invalidation of this bearish read is a sustained reclaim of 2,351.55, which would reopen the bullish case toward 2,526.62.

Bias stays SELL and the short remains live: price at 282.22 has extended further below the 316.60 entry and 319.11 stop, with the 1H trend down and the 1D bearish, though the combined signal has softened from SELL to HOLD. The prior read is confirmed on direction but the momentum has cooled — the slide from 285.11 to 282.22 is only ~1.0% versus the prior ~5.5% leg, and the last 1H bar is a modest +0.37% bounce off 281.90. A new bear FVG at 283.97–284.43 has opened directly overhead, giving the first imbalance since the break; it caps the bounce and keeps the 317.86–319.98 shelf sliced with 316.60 still the lower pivot and invalidation line. Target remains 273.80; invalidation is a reclaim back above 316.60, and any push back through 319.11 would neutralize the break. Regime is NEUTRAL, so size accordingly.

LLY extends the confirmed long, now at 1,432.99 (+3.5% from the prior read's 1,385.00), holding well above the 1,321.21 entry and the 1,309.67 stop, so the prior long bias is confirmed and unchanged. The 1D bullish and combined 1D+1H BUY regime persist, the 1H trend remains up, and FVGs stay empty, with no trend flip or gap fill to flag. Bias stays long toward the 1,511.21 target, with invalidation a break below 1,309.67, which would void the position and reopen downside toward the 1,131.21 lower pivot. The one shift is the regime reading NEUTRAL versus the prior read's framing, and the last 1H bar (1,364.55→1,367.51, +0.22%) still shows consolidation rather than acceleration, so momentum lags price.

META has rolled back over: price at 628.56 has lost the 633.27 reclaimed support and sits below the 629.16 stop, so the prior read's neutral-to-cautious-long stance is invalidated and the bias reverts to bearish, confirmed by the 1H downtrend and 1D+1H HOLD. The 629.10–629.28 bear FVG now caps price directly overhead, with the 635.10–639.80 FVG above that, while the downside targets the 614.48–622.08 and 613.25–616.80 bull FVGs as cushions. A clean reclaim of 633.27 would neutralize the bear case again, but acceptance below 622.08 opens the deeper leg toward the 495.27 target.

MSFT's bias has flipped from WATCHING-defensive to BUY: price reclaimed 556.89, decisively closing back above the 551.15 breakout level that the prior read flagged as the re-validation trigger, and the 1H trend has flipped back up with the combined 1D+1H signal upgraded from HOLD to BUY. The 510.31 downside pivot is now well out of play, and the prior bearish path is invalidated. The setup is a long from 551.15 with stop 547.83 and target 591.99, though the last 1H bar's 528.03→528.46 grind is a slow follow-through and the NEUTRAL regime keeps conviction modest. Bias is BUY; a close back below 551.15 invalidates the long, and a break of 547.83 confirms failure.

Bias flips to neutral: price at 225.12 has reclaimed the 221.32 invalidation that capped the prior bearish read, so the short setup is void and the combined regime has shifted from SELL to HOLD. The 1H trend has also turned up (212.73→212.84), confirming the momentum reversal, and the bear FVG overhead at 215.33–216.33 has been cleared with no open FVGs remaining. The 1D direction stays bearish, so this is a countertrend bounce rather than a trend flip — the 210.18 entry and 176.99 target are now stale, and the relevant levels are the 243.37 upper pivot as resistance and 210.18 as support. Invalidation of the neutral stance is a sustained break back below 210.18, which would revive the bearish case.

The prior bullish read is void: price has broken below the 101.14 level that was to hold, and the 101.55 line that had to stay intact, so the setup has flipped to SELL with 4H bearish, 1H trending down, and the combined read bearish. The bullish FVG at 100.96–101.74 is gone with no open FVGs remaining, and price at 96.62 sits well below the 101.14 lower pivot, confirming the breakdown rather than a pullback. Bias is bearish toward the 93.08 target, with 101.14 now the invalidation — a reclaim above it would neutralize the short. The 109.20 upper pivot is distant and not in play; the immediate risk is a bounce back into the 101.14 zone, which would invalidate the SELL.

TSLA's long bias holds but continues to erode: price slipped further from 405.50 to 399.17, extending the fade from the 431.84 target while still sitting above the 388.86 upper pivot. The 1D direction remains Bullish and the combined signal still reads HOLD, with the 1H trend up and a shallow -0.12% pullback leg, so structure is intact but momentum has weakened for a second consecutive read. Bias stays long above 388.86 with stop 385.35 and target 431.84, though the entry remains expired and price is now within roughly 10 points of invalidation. Invalidation is a close back below 388.86, and a break of 345.88 would flip the broader structure bearish.

The bearish bias holds but the setup stays expired: price at 52.37 has now broken the 52.38 floor flagged in the prior read, yet the 1H has flipped to a +0.52% bounce (52.10→52.37), so the break is not extending and the combined signal has shifted from SELL to HOLD. That is the key change — the deceleration noted before has turned into a counter-move off the lows, leaving the 54.38 entry untriggered and 50.14 still the downside target. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim above 54.61 flips bias toward 58.61, while a clean break and hold below 52.38 reopens 50.14. Watch whether this bounce fails at the 54.38 pivot or builds into a real reclaim — that decides whether the bearish read survives.

Bias stays SELL: price at 4,022.86 is essentially unchanged from the prior 4,023.72, and the 4H bearish structure with 1H downtrend still governs, though the combined signal has softened to HOLD. The key shift is the lower pivot, now 3,988.82 versus the prior 3,978.18, so the short trigger sits slightly higher with entry 3,988.82, stop 3,997.41, and target 3,894.82. The 1H bar closed up (+0.27%) and the FVG book remains empty, so there is still no overhead draw to stall a downside break. Invalidation stays at 4,082.82; until reclaimed, rallies toward the upper pivot remain sellable, and a break of 3,988.82 activates the short.

Price broke below the 1.2954 bull FVG and the 1.25 lower pivot, now at 1.24, so the prior neutral-to-softly-bearish stance is confirmed and hardened into a SELL as the combined 4H+1H alignment flipped from HOLD to SELL. The 1H downtrend persists with the last candle closing lower at 1.28, and with no open FVGs the structural footholds that supported the earlier bounce are gone. The 1.32 upper pivot and 1.3211–1.3246 bear FVG remain the overhead cap, and the expired BUY at 1.32 with 1.38 target stays void. Bias is bearish below 1.25; invalidation is a decisive reclaim of 1.25 and close above 1.32 that fills the upper bear FVG, which would flip the case bullish.
